code:
use default

insertion_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    for i in 1..values.count do
        let sought = values[i]
        let j mut = i - 1

        while j >= 0 /\ values[j] > sought do
            values[j + 1] = values[j]
            j = j - 1
        od

        values[j + 1] = sought
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

insertion_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))
